_: Linking area: Settings → C-Sweet account (IL-11), where an administrator links this Headquarters to a C-Sweet account, or moves the link to a different C-Sweet service.
Linking.Title: C-Sweet account
Linking.Intro: Link this Headquarters to your C-Sweet account so your phone can find it and connect through C-Sweet. Local accounts, passwords and recovery codes stay as they are.
Linking.LoadFailed: Couldn't load the link status. Refresh to try again.
Linking.NotLinked: This Headquarters isn't linked to C-Sweet.
Linking.Mismatch: This Headquarters is linked to {linked}, but it's now set to use {configured}. Link it again to move it there.
Linking.Disabled: Linking to C-Sweet is turned off for this Headquarters.
Linking.NameHint: You and the people you invite see this name in the C-Sweet app.
Linking.Waiting.Title: Approve on C-Sweet
Linking.Waiting.Lead: Open C-Sweet, sign in and check that it shows this code before you approve.
Linking.Approved.Title: Approved
Linking.Approved.Lead: Approved by {email}. Enter your Headquarters password to finish.
Linking.Done: Linked. Your phone can now find this Headquarters in C-Sweet.
Linking.Denied: The approval was declined on C-Sweet.
Linking.Expired: The approval code expired. Start again.
Linking.Unavailable: C-Sweet can't be reached right now. Try again later.
Linking.AccountInUse: That C-Sweet account is already linked to another person on this Headquarters.
Linking.LinkFailed: Couldn't link this Headquarters. Try again.
